notes: Loop 3 (was 8.3). German phone first: report-phone.png, every /try screen (try-phone-01…11), try-report-phone.png, try-rehearsal-phone.png, the result, price and AI demos, then ES/PL/dark, with 3× crops of the charts. I also rendered a /try report whose worst case is a gain. All six loop-2 items are fixed (see loop2). On a phone, step 5 now opens with the uptake dots and the R1–R4 grid, with short labels and no words broken mid-word. The landing sketches are correct. One word per idea holds on every page. The six interview answers differ and match each grid. A /try report now offers a rule-based rehearsal that brings step 5 to 'Fertig'. The price demo now answers its wage question with a chart and five dated facts. What holds it back: (1) With owner numbers, the bar chart's zero line runs through the row labels ('3 pro|Tag', 'Mindestlohn|kostet'; charts.ts:133). (2) In /try, the test costs of 0 € that set the break-even are hidden behind a caps label with no chevron. (3) The /try rehearsal has no events and no replay, and the owner's run in the evidence is mostly 'Nicht da'. (4) In the after-test number line, the stems cross the labels.
improvements: Rehearsal on /try (src/report/rehearsal.ts:238 has one button; mount.ts:405-420). The landing promises 'Sie können ein Ereignis einbauen — einen BVG-Streik, eine Woche Regen, ein Angebot der Konkurrenz — und sehen, was sich ändert' (site/src/lib/messages-de.ts:142, r.f3). An owner without an AI app gets one fixed run and cannot add an event or play it again. In the evidence that run is thin (try-rehearsal-phone.png, try-rehearsal.txt:242-349): 2 of 6 noticed, 1 tried, 0 came back, 0 told, and 12 of 24 grid cells are 'Nicht da' or 'Isst woanders'. Under the grid, add chips for the 8 BERLIN_EVENTS ('Vor Runde 3: BVG-Streik', 'Neues Café mit Mittagstisch für 8,50 €' …) and a 'Noch einmal, mit anderen ausgedachten Gästen' button. Both re-run ruleBasedReactions in the browser, label the run 'einfache Regeln, keine KI' and show what changed ('Probiert: 1 → 3'). Why: rehearsal visuals and hands-on learning on the closed-beta main path. A second run with different results also teaches 'a rehearsal, not a forecast'. Done when a /try report can add an event and the grid shows ⚡ in R3, and ui-try-rehearsal presses one event.

Zero line through the row labels (src/report/charts.ts:133). The worst-case line is now drawn only in the bar bands (:143-144), but the solid zero line still runs the full chart height, through every row label left of it. That happens whenever positive values dominate: try-report-phone.png step 3 ('Vorsichtig 3 pro|Tag', 'Erwartet 8 pro|Tag', 'Optimistisch 15 pro|Tag') and report-price-phone.png 'Deckt der neue Preis den höheren Mindestlohn?' ('bringt pro|Woche', 'Mindestlohn|kostet'). So the closed-beta owner sees it on her own first chart. Draw the zero line per bar band, as at :144, with a short tick under the '0 €: plus minus null' label. Or give .wi-row-label a halo (paint-order: stroke; stroke: var(--wi-surface); stroke-width: 4px). Why: charts must be readable at 390 px. Done when 3× crops of both charts show no line through text, and a check intersects wi-zero segments with row-label boxes for the /try and demo-price reports.

Filled-in test costs in a /try report (src/report/sections.ts:316-326, styles.ts:852-853, sections.ts:197-200). The owner skipped screen 9, so What-IF used 0 € for setup, 0 staff hours and 0 € for promotion. The report then says 'Ab 4 zusätzlichen Mittagsgästen pro Tag holt das Angebot den Test herein' (try-report.txt:285). The only sign in view is the grey caps line 'VON WHAT-IF EINGESETZT: BITTE PRÜFEN (7)' at the end of step 2. It is a <summary> with display:flex, so it has no chevron and reads as a heading with nothing under it (3× crop). filledWarning shows the 'Zuerst prüfen' callout only when the break-even is ≤ 0 or the worst case is no loss, so here it stays silent. Style that summary like the other folds (chevron, link colour). Whenever a cost in ZERO_COSTS was filled with 0, show one line above the short answer: 'Ohne Testkosten gerechnet: Startkosten 0 €, Personal 0 Std., Werbung 0 €. Stimmt das?' Why: source labels and honesty. A break-even built on the stand-in values must say so where it is shown. Done when try-report-phone.png shows the three 0-cost assumptions without a tap.

After-test number line (src/report/charts.ts:503-547, 'Wo die Wirklichkeit gelandet ist' in report-result-phone.png). The greedy label rows keep labels apart from each other, but stems from higher rows run down through lower labels: the stem at 7 cuts 'Erwartet: 8', and the stem at 8 runs into 'Holt den Test herein: 11'. Before placing a label in a row, check that no stem from a higher row crosses its box, or put the two break-even marks below the axis. Also, the paragraph above says 'erwarteten Szenario' twice ('…gegenüber −118 € in Ihrem erwarteten Szenario. Das liegt nah an Ihrem erwarteten Szenario.'). Write 'Gemessen 6 statt geschätzt 8: 66 € unter Ihrer wahrscheinlichen Schätzung, am nächsten an ihr'. Why: the learning-loop chart is the one a judge remembers. Done when a 3× crop shows no stem through text.

/try screens 7, 9 and 11 (try-phone-07/09/11.png, site/src/lib/messages-de.ts:373, src/engine/messages.de.ts:79). Screen 9, 'Was kostet Sie der Test?', puts five inputs under one heading and has no 'Warum das wichtig ist' box. One of the five, 'Geld, das Sie ohne Sorgen in einen Test stecken könnten', is not a cost of the test. Screen 7 asks 'und was gehört dazu?' but has only a € field. The review screen is 4,300 px tall, with 12 assumed inputs open. Split screen 9 into the costs (with a why and a 'Fällt nicht an' button per field, so 0 is a choice, not a skip) and 'Wie viel könnten Sie entbehren?' (why: 'Der Bericht stellt den schlimmsten Fall daneben'). Drop 'und was gehört dazu' or add a text field. On the review screen, fold the assumed inputs into a short list with 'Ändern'. Why: one question per screen with a why is the wizard's own scaffold. Done when try-phone.txt has a why on every input screen and try-phone-11.png is under 2,500 px.

Phone length and the facts card (styles.ts:731-732). Opened as shipped, report-phone.png is 12,926 px, or 15.3 screens. ui-report-height passes at 13.7 screens only after it closes the two sections that open by default. In the facts card, '.wi-fact-v { white-space: nowrap }' lets the value ('7 % seit dem 1. Januar 2026') take the right column, so the label wraps to 5-6 short lines ('Mehrwertsteuer auf / Speisen in Cafés und / Restaurants (vor Ort / und zum / Mitnehmen)'). Spanish is worse: 'IVA de la / comida en / cafeterías y …'. Below 480 px, stack the value under the label. Measure the report as the owner sees it, then fold something low-value on phones, for example 'Was Ihre Zahlen schon sagen' or the tabs row, to get back under 14 screens. Why: polish at phone width. Done when ui-report-height passes with the default-open sections left open.
